objective: Find US-government public-domain pickleball or adaptable racket-sport footage in NARA (catalog.archives.gov) and US agency film/video archives, register every candidate with a quoted license/PD basis, and download only clearly-cleared items (<200 MB) as label-blind fresh candidates.

downloaded.note: No item found that is both clearly US-government public domain and pickleball-relevant. Nothing was added to the corpus or to fresh-candidates. No labels were created.

nara.method: catalog.archives.gov records/search API queried through the site's own proxy endpoint from an in-browser fetch (direct curl requests are served the SPA HTML by the WAF)

pickleballAllTypes.finding: All 15 records are Textual Records: Trademark Official Gazette issues, White House daily diaries/news reports, a National Children's Study resource guide.

adaptableRacketSportMovingImages.finding: Every inspected item is 'Restricted - Possibly' (Copyright or Public Law 101-246) and/or has no downloadable digital objects; content is mostly 1940s-1970s military newsreel film with seconds of incidental play. The 2010-era Warrior Games items predate pickleball's inclusion in the event.
adaptableRacketSportMovingImages.notRetrieved: the 'tennis' moving-image count (proxy returned SPA HTML twice); not needed for the pickleball conclusion

itemsInspectedInDetail: NAID 543949313 Harlem Day Camp (paddle tennis; only downloadable racket-play MP4s found, 216/221 MB reels; Harmon Foundation donated collection with quoted possible third-party copyright -> quarantined)
NAID 52717 The Chinese National Table Tennis Team Visits the United States (USIA; quoted Public Law 101-246 restriction; no digital objects -> quarantined)
NAID 602178033 Around the Services 2009 (sole racquetball hit; interview segment, no gameplay; restricted-possibly; no digital objects -> quarantined)
NAID 560674304 / 542331424 Danang Sports Festival reels (badminton; USMC film but catalog status 'Restricted - Possibly (Copyright)'; digital objects are catalog-card JPG scans, not video)

nasa.finding: NHQ20230209ARMD01 'The Quiet Crew | Sriram Rallabhandi' (141 s): frame inspection of the downloaded medium rendition shows ~5 s of extremely distant recreational play on a tennis court; gameplay shots appear to be interviewee-contributed personal footage (NASA guidelines flag possible third-party material) with no perception value. Excluded, not added to the corpus. 'badminton' video search: 0.

agencyMediaRooms.finding: Text articles and photos only (VA pickleball clinics, NPS court planning documents); defense.gov video pages embed DVIDS-hosted media already covered by the DVIDS re-check. No new downloadable US-government pickleball video outside DVIDS.

conclusion: NARA holds zero pickleball moving images (15/15 pickleball hits are textual). Adaptable racket-sport holdings are decades-old restricted-possibly film with no clear PD basis and near-zero perception value. DVIDS is confirmed still exhausted (16/16 videos already in corpus). US-government archives are a dead end for new pickleball footage; supply must come from CC-licensed community video (Wave C c16 path) or first-party consent-based collection.
